$comment: Frozen sprite slot list (contract 2.0.0). Sizes and anchors are in sprite pixels at render scale 1. space: world = drawn on the iso grid; rack = drawn on the rack front elevation (orthographic, 1U = 8 px); screen = UI overlay. Anchor = the sprite pixel that is placed on the object's ground point (world: top corner of its footprint tile, see iso.md; rack: top-left of the U slot; screen: the pointer/frame origin).

slots.use: A site on the overworld (2x2 tiles, 48 px tall).
One floor tile of a room.

Wall on the N (-y) edge of a tile: runs from the tile top corner screen down-right to its right corner, 32 px tall. The engine mirrors it horizontally (anchor becomes [16, 32]) for the W (-x) edge. S and E edges are never drawn (they would hide the room).
A rack on the room grid, front facing S (variant.rotation turns it). 48 px tall.
Generic 1U faceplate; tinted by variant.role_color.
Generic 2U faceplate (3U devices use 2U + 1U, 5U+ stack 4U).
Generic 4U faceplate.
1U faceplate for role switch (port row + LEDs).
1U faceplate for roles router and firewall.
1U faceplate for role patch-panel.
1U faceplate for role pdu. Also every zero-U device (device_type.u_height 0, any role): drawn with variant.rotation 1 (8x64, vertical) on the rack's side rail.
One U of the rack frame at rack zoom: 8 px rail each side and the empty slot between. Stacked u_height times under the faceplates; the anchor is where a faceplate's top-left goes.
One port at device zoom (any PortKind). variant.status: 'connected', 'free', 'disabled' or 'mgmt'; variant.wire_color = the cable colour when connected.
Floor wire/cable tray along +x (variant.rotation 1 = along +y). Tinted by variant.wire_color.
Corner joining -x and +y edges at rotation 0; rotations 1-3 turn 90 degrees clockwise on screen.
Crossing of x and y runs.
Small prop standing at the tile centre (variant.seed picks one of the theme's props).
Large prop filling a tile, 32 px tall.
9-slice panel frame: 8 px corners, 8 px edges, 8x8 centre.
Tile selector outline under the pointer.
Ring around the selected object's footprint tile (1 px larger than a tile on every side).
